Media Library

Here you’ll find things to listen to, read and watch in Swedish at your own pace: a monthly magazine in PDF format, a podcast for learning the language and a video show coming soon to YouTube.

Monthly magazine

A digital magazine in Swedish

Once a month – a neat PDF issue in Swedish: text, words, cultural context and exercises. You can get the first issue for free, and after that it’s by subscription.

Download the first issue for free Subscribe – €10/month

No card needed for the first issue. You can cancel your subscription at any time.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

How do I get the first issue of the magazine?

You’ll have it as soon as you download it – a PDF file that you can open on your phone or computer.

What happens after the first issue?

To get later issues, you need a subscription for €10 a month. You can cancel it at any time.

Is the podcast really free?

Yes, the basic version is available now for free. The paid version with extra episodes and exercises is coming very soon.

When will the Slow Swedish Morning Show come out?

The launch is planned for January 2027. The show will be completely free, aesthetically pleasing and incredibly useful.
